I don’t have real‑time clock data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York right now.  
If you need the current time, you can:

1. **Check your phone or computer’s world clock** – most devices let you add New York (or “Eastern Time”) as a city.  
2. **Use an online time‑zone converter** – sites like timeanddate.com or worldtimebuddy.com will show the current Eastern Time (ET) instantly.  
3. **Ask a smart assistant** – Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc., can answer “What time is it in New York?” on demand.

If you’re curious about the time difference: New York is usually 4 hours behind UTC during daylight‑saving time (which is in effect until the first Sunday in November). So if you know the current UTC time, subtract 4 hours to get Eastern Daylight Time.
